description.en: Video toolbox over ffmpeg: transcode, frame extraction, GIF, subtitle burn-in, trim and concat, speed, watermark, snapshot and storyboard. Keywords: video, ffmpeg, transcode, frames, GIF, subtitles. MIT.
description.zh: 视频工具箱（聚合 ffmpeg）：转码、抽帧、GIF、字幕烧录、裁剪拼接、变速、水印、截图、storyboard 批量。关键词：视频 video、ffmpeg、转码 transcode、抽帧、GIF、字幕。MIT。
